answer: Neighborhood closure requirement: an agent is admitted only if its attestations form a dense local cluster that stays mutually reachable as the network's tundra of idle edges shifts. Enforcement checks that each identity's neighbors share overlapping paths to a common garden of verified peers; isolated spokes fail. Reaching the required closure forces an attacker to sustain many interlinked identities, paying maintenance traffic and link costs per identity at the summit of each epoch.
